world.title: Macron urges world to choose UN over ‘law of the jungle’
world.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron urged global unity under the United Nations, emphasizing the need to reject chaos and the "law of the jungle." In his speech at the UN's annual diplomatic gathering, he advocated for humanitarian protections in conflict zones like Gaza and Ukraine, calling on nations to recommit to international laws and the UN system.

world.title: MEN OF BRICS: Officers who shaped Summit success
world.summary: Indian bureaucrats and diplomats were instrumental in the success of the 18th Annual BRICS Summit held in India. They coordinated negotiations and built consensus among 11 diverse member states, effectively overcoming significant geopolitical divides within the expanded bloc. Their efforts included managing year-long diplomatic preparations, which contributed to the overall effectiveness and outcomes of the summit.

world.title: Trump's White House media ban faces long odds in court, legal experts say
world.summary: US President Donald Trump's attempt to ban certain news outlets from the White House due to unfavorable coverage may violate legal prohibitions against government viewpoint discrimination, according to four legal experts. They suggest that the ban faces significant challenges in court, as it could be seen as an infringement on press freedoms protected under the First Amendment.

business.title: Govt set to consider auto PLI applications with Chinese investment after FDI nod
business.summary: The Indian government plans to review production-linked incentive applications from auto companies with Chinese investments, following President Xi Jinping's recent visit and improved bilateral relations. Applications with foreign direct investment approvals will be evaluated for potential benefits. The auto production-linked incentive scheme aims to enhance domestic manufacturing and investments, with expected increases in disbursements in upcoming financial years.

business.title: Ban on US diesel exports would hurt, not help fuel markets, analysts say
business.summary: US President Donald Trump expressed support for a diesel export ban to reduce soaring prices amid a global supply shortage. However, analysts caution that this measure may not alleviate high energy costs and could exacerbate supply issues and economic disruptions worldwide. The potential impact of such a ban raises concerns about its effectiveness in addressing the current fuel market challenges.

business.title: Natural Gas Forecast: 200-Day Breakout Targets $3.25
business.summary: Natural gas has reclaimed its 200-day moving average, with a confirmed breakout above $3.15 suggesting a potential rise toward $3.25. This sharp upside movement indicates a strong trend support and the likelihood of continued advancement. The session's peak reached $3.15, marking a significant point in the ongoing price development for natural gas.

technology.title: premium Signature 27 will be one the first phones powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
technology.summary: Motorola's premium Signature 27 will feature Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 processor. The smartphone is set to launch in the United States, although a specific release date has not yet been announced. Its design includes a thin aluminum body and a unique camera layout with four lenses, generating mixed reactions among potential users.

Its comprehensive set of running-focused features makes it appealing to fitness enthusiasts. Currently, it is available on AliExpress at a reduced price due to a double discount, attracting significant consumer interest.

technology.title: Deposition Process on Coating Integrity and Wear of Fe-Based Coatings
technology.summary: Fe-based coatings are widely used in surface engineering to improve the durability of components exposed to wear. The deposition process and its impact on coating integrity and wear resistance are critical for enhancing performance. Research by Branagan, Swank, Haggard, and Fincke in 2001 highlights the effectiveness of wear-resistant amorphous and nanocomposite steel coatings in metallurgical applications.

sports.title: ‘I can start my senior career confidently’: Anahat Singh on the Asian Games and what comes next
sports.summary: Anahat Singh expressed confidence in starting her senior career following her victory at the World Junior Squash Championship. She emphasized that her win was not about enhancing her profile but marked the end of her junior circuit participation. Looking ahead, Singh is focused on the upcoming Asian Games and is eager to transition into senior-level competition.

sports.title: India at Asian Games: Live updates from Day 4 action on September 23, 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya
sports.summary: India is set for an exciting Day 4 at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, aiming to enhance their medal tally. Notable athletes, including Manu Bhaker and Mirabai Chanu, will compete in their respective events. Live updates will cover the progress and performances of the Indian contingent as they strive for success in the ongoing competition.

sports.title: SAC vs TSC Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score

The match is scheduled for September 23, 2026, at 06:00 IST, taking place at Karen Rolton Oval in Adelaide. This encounter follows South Australia's opening game against Western Australia, setting the stage for an exciting domestic one-day cricket clash.

health.title: Health Ministry warns against misuse of painkillers, antibiotics over kidney disease risk
health.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) has issued an advisory warning against the indiscriminate use of painkillers, especially Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs), and antibiotics. The advisory targets healthcare professionals, pharmacists, retailers, distributors, hospitals, and the public, emphasizing the potential risks associated with these medications, particularly their link to Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD).

health.title: Sex-specific associations between DXA-derived arms fat-to-lean ratio and sarcopenia in Taiwanese patients with type 2 diabetes: a cross-sectional study
health.summary: A study of 103 Taiwanese adults with type 2 diabetes examined sex-specific associations between fat-to-lean ratios and sarcopenia. Prevalence was 15% in females and 23.3% in males. Males showed higher lean mass and grip strength, while females had higher fat ratios. The arms fat-to-lean ratio was linked to increased sarcopenia odds in males, highlighting the importance of regional body composition.

health.title: Global, regional, and national impact of epidemic disasters on health workforce equality between 1990 and 2019: An ecological and modeling study
health.summary: A study by Manman Chen, Wanzhou Wang, and colleagues analyzed the impact of infectious disease epidemics on health workforce changes across 194 countries from 1990 to 2019. Findings indicate that epidemic events resulted in significant health workforce losses globally, with the most pronounced effects in low- and middle-income countries, highlighting disparities in health workforce equity during epidemic crises.

science.title: The role of shape and interaction directionality in the crystalline phase behaviour of octahedral metal-organic cages
science.summary: Researchers have developed a computational methodology combining semi-empirical dimer calculations and coarse-grained modeling to predict the packing behavior of metal-organic cages (MOCs). This approach enhances understanding of how molecular shape and interaction directionality affect crystalline phase behavior. The findings aim to facilitate the rational design of MOCs with tailored solid-state structures and properties, addressing challenges in crystal engineering.

science.title: NASA finds evidence of repeated water activity on Mars
science.summary: NASA's Perseverance rover has discovered evidence of water interaction in rocks at Mars' Jezero Crater on at least three occasions. This finding, reported by Qazinform News Agency, enhances understanding of Mars' history with water. The evidence was found in the "Margin Unit," a geological area near the ancient lake's shoreline, where scientists anticipated sedimentary rocks but found igneous ones instead.

science.title: A Feather in Dinosaur Poop May Explain How Birds Beat Extinction
science.summary: A researcher discovered a fossilized dinosaur dung ball in Montana in 2016, which contained a feather. This finding may provide insights into how some bird species survived the mass extinction event that wiped out dinosaurs. The preserved feather could help scientists understand the evolutionary advantages that allowed certain birds to thrive while others perished.
